text: Àwọn lẹ́tà. Níbí, a ó kọ́ àwọn lẹ́tà Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

text: Wá àwòrán. A ó sọ orúkọ nǹkan kan, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ àwòrán rẹ̀.
en: Find the picture. The name of a thing will be said, then tap its picture.

text: Ìkọ̀wé. Níbí, a ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kọ ọ̀rọ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

text: Yan ẹ̀kọ́ kan, láti gbọ́ nípa rẹ̀ sí i.
en: Pick a lesson, to hear more about it.

text: Gbogbo àwọn lẹ́tà nìyí. Jẹ́ ká kọ́ wọn ní ìpín-ìpín.
en: Here are all the letters. Let's learn them group by group.

text: Ẹranko. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa oríṣiríṣi ẹranko tí ó ń gbé ní àyíká wa.
en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

text: Ara. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa oríṣiríṣi ẹ̀yà ara ènìyàn.
en: The body. This lesson is about the different parts of the human body.

text: Oúnjẹ. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa oríṣiríṣi oúnjẹ tí a ń jẹ lójoojúmọ́.
en: Food. This lesson is about the different foods we eat every day.

text: Ohun èlò ilé. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn nǹkan tí a ń lò nínú ilé.
en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

text: Àyíká. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn nǹkan tí ó wà láyé àti ní àyíká wa.
en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

text: Ọkọ̀. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa mọ́tò àti oríṣiríṣi ọkọ̀ tí a ń wọ̀.
en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ẹranko. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of animals. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ẹ̀yà ara. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of body parts. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán oúnjẹ. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of food. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ohun èlò ilé. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of household things. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán nǹkan àyíká. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of things in nature. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kà nọ́mbà. A ó fi àwọn ìka ọwọ́ hàn ọ́. Kà àwọn ìka tí a gbé sókè, lẹ́yìn náà, sọ nọ́mbà náà ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll learn to count. Fingers will be shown. Count the fingers that are up, then say the number in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ọkọ̀. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of vehicles. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Ó dára gan-an!
en: Well done!

text: tẹ̀ pátákó dúdú.
en: press the black slate.

text: Tẹ̀ àwòrán nǹkan tí a dárúkọ.
en: Tap the picture of the thing that was named.

text: Rárá, kì í ṣe èyí. Tún fetí sílẹ̀, kí o sì tún gbìyànjú.
en: No, not that one. Listen again, try again.

text: Ó dára gan-an! Báyìí, o ti lè kàwé!
en: Well done! Now you can read!

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ kan nìyí. A ó jọ kà ọ̀rọ̀ yìí. Lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Here is a word. We'll read this word together. Letter by letter.

text: Báyìí, kà odindi ọ̀rọ̀ náà sókè.
en: Now read the whole word, out loud.

text: Fetí sílẹ̀, èyí ni
en: Listen, this is

text: Rárá, tún gbìyànjú.
en: No, try again.

text: Báyìí, a ó da wọ́n pọ̀.
en: Now we'll mix them up.

text: Báyìí, kọ ọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì. Ọ̀nà méjì ló wà.
en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́.
en: Tap or say the first letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà kejì.
en: Tap or say the second letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà kẹta.
en: Tap or say the third letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà kẹrin.
en: Tap or say the fourth letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà karùn-ún.
en: Tap or say the fifth letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà kẹfà.
en: Tap or say the sixth letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà keje.
en: Tap or say the seventh letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà kẹjọ.
en: Tap or say the eighth letter.

text: Tẹ̀ tàbí sọ lẹ́tà kẹsàn-án.
en: Tap or say the ninth letter.

text: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, kí o sì sọ lẹ́tà náà.
en: Press Fúnkẹ́ and say the letter.

text: Tàbí kí o tẹ̀ lẹ́tà èyíkéyìí.
en: Or tap any letter.

text: Ó dára gan-an! O ti parí ìpín yìí.
en: Well done! You've finished this group.

text: Oríṣiríṣi ẹ̀kọ́ nìyí. Tẹ̀ àwòrán èyíkéyìí láti mọ̀ ohun tí ó wà nínú rẹ̀.
en: Here are the different lessons. Tap any picture to find out what's in it.

text: Kọ ọ́, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Write it, letter by letter.

text: Báyìí, ìdánwò! Kọ ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan wọn, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Now, a test! Write each one, letter by letter.

text: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti bẹ̀rẹ̀.
en: Press Fúnkẹ́ to start.

text: Èyí ni
en: This is

text: Bí bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́,
en: If not,

text: Nígbàkígbà tí o bá fẹ́ sọ̀rọ̀, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́. Màá fetí sílẹ̀ dáadáa!
en: Whenever you want to speak, press Fúnkẹ́. I'll listen carefully!

text: Báwo ni! Bí o bá jẹ́ ọmọbìnrin, tẹ̀ èyí tí ó funfun. Bí o bá jẹ́ ọmọkùnrin, tẹ̀ èyí tí ó pupa.
en: Hello! If you are a girl, tap the white one. If you are a boy, tap the red one.

text: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, sọ lẹ́tà tí o rí.
en: Press Fúnkẹ́, then say the letter you see.

text: Àwọn nǹkan. Níbí, a ó kọ́ orúkọ àwọn nǹkan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, pẹ̀lú àwòrán.
en: Things. Here we learn the names of things in English, with pictures.

text: Ó dára gan-an! Báyìí, o ti mọ̀ gbogbo lẹ́tà àti ọ̀rọ̀.
en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

text: Ẹnìkan wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ. Jọ̀ọ́, jókòó ní ìwọ nìkan níwájú kámẹ́rà.
en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

text.m: Láti padà sẹ́yìn, tẹ̀ ilẹ̀kùn yìí.
text.f: Láti padà sẹ́yìn, tẹ̀ ilẹ̀kùn yìí.

en: Welcome back!

text: Iṣẹ́. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn nǹkan tí a ń ṣe lójoojúmọ́. Bí jíjẹ, mímu, sísáré àti ṣíṣeré.
en: Actions. This lesson is about the things we do every day. Like eating, drinking, running and playing.

text: Aṣọ. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn aṣọ tí a ń wọ̀.
en: Clothing. This lesson is about the clothes we wear.

text: Ènìyàn. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn ènìyàn tí ó yí wa ká. Màmá, bàbá, àwọn ọmọdé àti àwọn olùkọ́.
en: People. This lesson is about the people around us. Mum, dad, children and teachers.

text: Ilé-ìwé. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn ohun èlò ilé-ìwé tí a ń lò.
en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán iṣẹ́. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of actions. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán aṣọ. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of clothes. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ènìyàn. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of people. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ohun èlò ilé-ìwé. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll see pictures of school things. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Súnmọ́ kámẹ́rà.
en: Come closer to the camera.

text: Láti tún gbọ́ ọ, tẹ̀ etí yìí.
en: To hear it again, press this ear.

text: Báyìí, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, ká bẹ̀rẹ̀.
en: Now press Fúnkẹ́ and we'll start.

text: Kíkà. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan, lẹ́yìn náà, gbogbo rẹ̀ papọ̀.
en: Reading. Here we read words, letter by letter, then all at once.

text: Báyìí, a ó kà orúkọ àwọn nǹkan wọ̀nyí ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Now we'll read the names of these things in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó ṣe ìdánwò kékeré lórí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí o ti kọ́. A ó fi ọ̀rọ̀ kan hàn ọ́, kí o sì kà á lódindi.
en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ kúkúrú. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ kúkúrú, tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́ta.
en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ alábọ́dé. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́rin àti márùn-ún.
en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn.
en: Long words. Here we read long words.

text: Nọ́mbà. Níbí, a ó kà orúkọ àwọn nọ́mbà ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó ṣe ìdánwò kékeré, láti rí i dájú pé o mọ̀ àwọn lẹ́tà tí o ti kọ́.
en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

text: Ìdánwò ńlá. Sọ gbogbo àwọn lẹ́tà, ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn èkejì.
en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

text: Ìdánwò ìkẹyìn. A ó da àwọn lẹ́tà pọ̀, a ó sì fi wọ́n hàn ọ́. Sọ gbogbo wọn.
en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

text: Lẹ́tà mẹ́rin nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, kí o sì wò wọ́n.
en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

text: Báyìí, wàá rí lẹ́tà tuntun méjì láti kọ́. Ìpele tuntun nìyí. Ó ṣe pàtàkì gan-an.
en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text: Báyìí, wàá rí lẹ́tà tuntun mẹ́rin láti kọ́. Ìpele tuntun nìyí. Ó ṣe pàtàkì gan-an.
en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text: Báyìí, sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.
en: Now you say it yourself.

text: Orúkọ mi ni Fúnkẹ́. Èmi ni ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ. Báyìí, tẹ̀ orí mi, ká bẹ̀rẹ̀.
en: My name is Fúnkẹ́. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

text: A fẹ́ parí ẹ̀kọ́ yìí. Bí o bá ti parí, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́. Bí bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́, tẹ̀ pátákó dúdú.
en: The session will end. If you are done, press Fúnkẹ́. If not, press the black slate.

text: Wá ibi tí ìmọ́lẹ̀ wà.
en: Find a brighter spot.

text: Jọ̀ọ́, dúró díẹ̀. A ń ṣètò gbogbo nǹkan.
en: Please wait a little. Everything is getting ready.

text: Wo kámẹ́rà.
en: Look at the camera.

text: Báyìí, ìdánwò ńlá! A ó dán gbogbo nọ́mbà tí o ti kọ́ wò, láti rí i dájú pé o mọ̀ wọ́n. A ó fi nọ́mbà kan hàn ọ́, a ó sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Yorùbá, ìwọ yóò sì sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì. Bí o bá ti gbàgbé orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì,
en: Now the big test! We'll test all the numbers you learned, to make sure you know them. A number will be shown, its name said in Yoruba, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

text: Báyìí, a ó tún kọ́ àwọn tí ó ṣòro fún ọ, pẹ̀lú díẹ̀ lára àwọn tí o mọ̀, láti túbọ̀ dánrawò.
en: Now we'll learn again the ones you struggled with, together with a few you know, for extra practice.

text: Báyìí, àwọn ọgọ́rọ̀ọ̀rún: igba, ọ̀ọ́dúnrún, títí dé ẹ̀ẹ́dẹ́gbẹ̀rún, lẹ́yìn náà, ẹgbẹ̀rún.
en: Now the hundreds: two hundred, three hundred, up to nine hundred, then a thousand.

text: Níbí, a ó kọ́ nọ́mbà. Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́, a ó fi ìka ọwọ́ kà, láti ọ̀kan dé mẹ́wàá. Lẹ́yìn náà, a ó kọ́ àmì àwọn nọ́mbà.
en: Here we learn numbers. First we count on our fingers, one to ten. Then we learn the number signs.

text: Ọwọ́ nìyí. Kà àwọn ìka tí a gbé sókè.
en: Here is a hand. Count the fingers that are up.

text: Báyìí, àmì àwọn nọ́mbà láti mọ́kànlá dé ogún.
en: Now the number signs from eleven to twenty.

text: Báyìí, a ó kọ́ àmì àwọn nọ́mbà tí o ti kọ́, láti ọ̀kan dé mẹ́wàá.
en: Now we'll learn the signs of the numbers you learned, one to ten.

text: Báyìí, a ó kọ́ àwọn nọ́mbà ńlá: ọgbọ̀n, ogójì, àádọ́ta, títí dé ọgọ́rùn-ún.
en: Now we'll learn the big numbers: thirty, forty, fifty, up to a hundred.

text: Tún fetí sílẹ̀. Ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, a ń pè é ní:
en: Listen again. In English, it is:

text: O ṣe gbogbo rẹ̀ dáadáa! Báyìí, jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú.
en: You got them all right! Now we go on.

text.m: Àwọn àwòrán tí wàá rí báyìí ni àwọn tí ó ṣòro fún ọ. A ó tún wọn kọ́.
text.f: Àwọn àwòrán tí wàá rí báyìí ni àwọn tí ó ṣòro fún ọ. A ó tún wọn kọ́.
text.any: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn wọ̀nyí kọ́.

en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

text: O lè ṣe é!
en: You can do it!

text: Ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, a ń pè é ní:
en: In English, it is:

text: Àwọn àwòrán nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, kí o sì wò wọ́n.
en: Here are three pictures. Listen and look.

text: Ìyẹn kò tọ̀nà. Jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú.
en: That one wasn't right. Let's go on.

text: Báyìí, àwòrán márùn-ún mìíràn nìyí.
en: Now here are five more pictures.

text: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká lọ sí èyí tí ó kàn.
en: Now, on to the next.

text: Àwọn kan kò tọ̀nà. A ó tún wọn kọ́, lẹ́yìn náà, a ó tún ìdánwò náà ṣe.
en: Some weren't right. We'll learn them again, then take the test again.

text: Àwọn tí o mọ̀ dáadáa nìyí:
en: Here are the ones you got right:

text: Sọ ọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Say it in English.

text: Báyìí, a ó ṣe ìdánwò kékeré, láti rí i dájú pé o mọ̀ wọ́n. A ó fi àwòrán kan hàn ọ́, a ó sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Yorùbá, ìwọ yóò sì sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì. Bí o bá ti gbàgbé orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì,
en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you know them. A picture will be shown, its name said in Yoruba, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

text: Ìyẹn ṣòro. Báyìí, jẹ́ ká lọ sí èyí tí ó kàn.
en: That one is hard. Now, on to the next.

text: Ó kàn ọ́. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, kí o sì sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Your turn. Press Fúnkẹ́ and say its name in English.

text: Àwọn wọ̀nyí náà, a ó tún wọn kọ́:
en: And these, we'll learn again:

text.m: A ó ya fídíò rẹ bí o ṣe ń sọ orúkọ rẹ. Bí àpẹẹrẹ, bí orúkọ rẹ bá jẹ́ Báyọ̀, sọ pé: Orúkọ mi ni Báyọ̀.
text.f: A ó ya fídíò rẹ bí o ṣe ń sọ orúkọ rẹ. Bí àpẹẹrẹ, bí orúkọ rẹ bá jẹ́ Fúnkẹ́, sọ pé: Orúkọ mi ni Fúnkẹ́.

en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Bayo, say: Orúkọ mi ni Bayo.

text.any: Ọmọkùnrin kan nìyí, Báyọ̀. Ó ń sọ orúkọ rẹ̀.
text.f: Ọmọbìnrin kan nìyí, Fúnkẹ́. Ó ń sọ orúkọ rẹ̀.

en: Here is the boy Bayo / the girl Funke, saying the name.

text: Báyìí, ìwọ ni. Sọ orúkọ rẹ fún wa. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, sọ orúkọ rẹ fún wa.
en: Now you: press Fúnkẹ́, then say your name.

text: A nílò kámẹ́rà àti máíkì kí èyí lè ṣiṣẹ́. Tẹ̀ 'Allow'.
en: We need the camera and the microphone for this to work. Tap 'Allow'.

text: A kò rí ìyọ̀ǹda gbà. Tún gbìyànjú, kí o sì tẹ̀ 'Allow'.
en: Permission was not given. Try again and tap 'Allow'.

text: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú, pẹ̀lú àwọn tuntun. Fetí sílẹ̀ dáadáa.
en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

text: Àwòrán mẹ́rin. A ó fi àwòrán mẹ́rin hàn ọ́, a ó sọ orúkọ ọ̀kan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì tẹ̀ ẹ́.
en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

text: Nọ́mbà. A ó sọ nọ́mbà kan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì tẹ̀ àmì rẹ̀.
en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

text: Tẹ̀ àmì nọ́mbà tí a sọ.
en: Tap the sign of the number that was said.

text: Níbí, a ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kọ orúkọ àwọn nǹkan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan. A ó fi àwòrán kan hàn ọ́, kí o sì kọ orúkọ rẹ̀.
en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

text: Ó kàn ọ́. Yan ẹ̀kọ́ kan.
en: Your turn. Pick a lesson.

text: O kú iṣẹ́!
en: Well done!

text: Lẹ́tà mẹ́ta. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́ta, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Three letters. Here we write three-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Lẹ́tà mẹ́rin. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́rin, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Four letters. Here we write four-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Lẹ́tà márùn-ún. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà márùn-ún, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Five letters. Here we write five-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Long words. Here we write long words, letter by letter.

text: Nọ́mbà. Níbí, a ó kọ orúkọ àwọn nọ́mbà ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
en: Numbers. Here we write the names of numbers in English, letter by letter.

text: N kò rí ọ dáadáa. Jọ̀ọ́, jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú.
en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

text: N kò gbọ́ orúkọ rẹ dáadáa. Jọ̀ọ́, jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú.
en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

text: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti tún gbìyànjú.
en: Click Fúnkẹ́ to try again.

text: Tàbí kí o tẹ̀ ilẹ̀kùn yìí láti padà sí ìbẹ̀rẹ̀.
en: Or click this door to go back and start again.

text: Báwo ni,
en: Hello,

text: Sọ ọ́ báyìí.
en: Say it now.

text: Lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́ ni:
en: The first letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà kejì ni:
en: The second letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà kẹta ni:
en: The third letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà kẹrin ni:
en: The fourth letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà karùn-ún ni:
en: The fifth letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà kẹfà ni:
en: The sixth letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà keje ni:
en: The seventh letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà kẹjọ ni:
en: The eighth letter is:

text: Lẹ́tà kẹsàn-án ni:
en: The ninth letter is:

text: Tẹ̀ ẹ́.
en: Tap it.

text: Báyìí ni a ṣe ń kọ ọ́:
en: It is written like this:

text: Dúró jẹ́ẹ́.
en: Hold still.

text: Káàbọ̀!
en: Welcome!

text: Àpẹẹrẹ! Wò ó, kí o sì gbọ́ bí a ṣe ń ṣe é.
en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

text: Èmi ni màá kà àwọn lẹ́tà náà, ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn èkejì. Fetí sílẹ̀.
en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

text: Ohun tí màá sọ nìyí:
en: Here is what I'll say:

text: Ó kàn ọ́. Gbìyànjú.
en: Your turn. Try it.

text: Orúkọ mi ni Fúnkẹ́. Èmi ni ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ.
en: My name is Fúnkẹ́. I am your learning friend.

text: Papọ̀, a ó kọ́ èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Together we are going to learn English.

text: Mo ní àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ tí ó dára gan-an.
en: I have amazing lessons.

text: A ó kọ́ àwọn lẹ́tà Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: We will learn the English alphabet.

text: A ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kàwé àti bí a ṣe ń kọ̀wé ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: We will learn to read and write in English.

text: A ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kà nọ́mbà.
en: We will learn to count.

text: A ó kọ́ orúkọ àwọn nǹkan, bí ẹranko àti oúnjẹ, ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

text: Àti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ nǹkan mìíràn tí ó dùn mọ́ni.
en: And many other amazing things.

text: Wàá lè bá mi sọ̀rọ̀. Màá wà pẹ̀lú rẹ.
en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

text: Inú mi dùn láti rí ọ.
en: I am happy to see you.

text: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú láti ibi tí a dúró sí.
en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

text: Ohun tí wàá ṣe láti sọ ọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìyí. Wàá tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, wàá sọ pé:
en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Fúnkẹ́, then you will say:

text: Ohun tí wàá ṣe láti kà á ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìyí. Wàá tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, wàá kà ọ̀rọ̀ náà:
en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Fúnkẹ́, then you will read the word:

text: Ohun tí wàá ṣe láti kọ ọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìyí. Wàá tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, wàá sọ àwọn lẹ́tà náà:
en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Fúnkẹ́, then you will say the letters:

text: Ohun tí wàá ṣe nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ àwòrán tí a dárúkọ.
en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

text: Ohun tí wàá ṣe nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ nọ́mbà tí a dárúkọ.
en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

text: Báyìí, a ó fi àwòrán mẹ́rin hàn ọ́. Fetí sí orúkọ tí a sọ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ ẹ́.
en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

text: Báyìí, a ó fi àwọn nọ́mbà hàn ọ́. Fetí sí èyí tí a sọ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ ẹ́.
en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

text: A ó sọ àwọn lẹ́tà náà, ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn èkejì. Ọ̀nà méjì ló wà.
en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.

text: Àkọ́kọ́, pẹ̀lú ohùn.
en: The first, with your voice.

text: Èkejì, pẹ̀lú pátákó.
en: The second, with the board.

text: Lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́, màá fi ohùn mi sọ ọ́.
en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.

text: Lẹ́tà kejì náà, màá fi ohùn mi sọ ọ́.
en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

text: Lẹ́tà ìkẹyìn ní tirẹ̀, màá tẹ̀ ẹ́ lórí pátákó.
en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

text: Àwọn bàlúù tí ó ní lẹ́tà nìyí. Fi ìka rẹ tẹ̀ bàlúù kan, yóò sì bẹ́.
en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

text: Ó dára gan-an, a ti parí eré náà!
en: Well done, we've finished the game!

text: Àpẹẹrẹ nìyí. Màá fọ́ àkọ́kọ́:
en: Here is an example. I'll pop the first one:

text: Ó kàn ọ́ báyìí.
en: Now you.

text: Fọ́ lẹ́tà tí ó tẹ̀lé
en: Pop the letter after

text: Wá lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì fọ́ ọ. Lẹ́yìn náà, lẹ́tà tí ó tẹ̀lé e, ní tẹ̀léntẹ̀lé.
en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it, in order.

text: Màá tún fi hàn ọ́. Fara balẹ̀.
en: I will show you again. Pay attention.

text: Kò tọ̀nà, ṣùgbọ́n wàá kọ́ ọ.
en: That was not right, but you will learn.

text: O ní àkókò láti parí gbogbo lẹ́tà, láti A dé Z.
en: You have time to finish all the letters, A to Z.

text: Bí o bá ṣe é dáadáa, àkókò yóò pọ̀ sí i. Bí o bá ṣe àṣìṣe, àkókò yóò dín kù.
en: Get it right and time goes up. Get it wrong and time goes down.

text: Bí àkókò bá tán, o kò borí. Ire o!
en: If the time runs out, you have not won. Good luck!

text: Àkókò ti tán. Jẹ́ ká kọ́ àwọn lẹ́tà ná.
en: Time is up. Let us learn the letters first.

text: O mọ̀ àwọn lẹ́tà rẹ.
en: You know your letters.

text: Ṣé o mọ̀ gbogbo lẹ́tà?
en: Do you know all the letters?

text: …títí dé Z?
en: …all the way to Z?

text: Bí o bá mọ̀ wọ́n, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́. Bí o kò bá mọ̀ wọ́n, tẹ̀ pátákó dúdú.
en: If you know them, tap Fúnkẹ́. If you do not, tap the slate.

text: Má ṣe dààmú. Jẹ́ ká kọ́ wọn ná.
en: Don't worry. Let us learn them first.

text: A ó ṣe eré kékeré kan.
en: We are going to play a little game.

text: Láti bẹ̀rẹ̀, tẹ̀ ìwé tó wà lókè yìí, ká bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́.
en: To start, tap the book up here to begin learning.

text: Tẹ̀ ìwé náà láti máa bá ẹ̀kọ́ lọ.
en: Tap the book to continue learning.

text: O tún lè tẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ kan, láti gbọ́ nípa rẹ̀ sí i.
en: You can also press a lesson to hear more about it.

text: Fọ́ lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́:
en: Pop the first letter:

text: Fọ́ lẹ́tà tó kàn.
en: Pop the next letter.

text: A fẹ́ mọ̀ dájú pé o mọ àwọn lẹ́tà Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, bíi
en: We want to make sure you know the English letters, like

text: Bí o bá mọ̀ wọ́n, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti bẹ̀rẹ̀.
en: If you know them, tap Fúnkẹ́ to begin.

text: Bí o kò bá mọ̀ wọ́n, kò burú, a ó jọ kọ́ wọn. Tẹ̀ pátákó dúdú láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́.
en: If you don't, no problem, we will learn them together. Tap the black slate to begin learning.

text: Mú ẹja tó gbé ohun tí mo bá sọ.
en: Catch the fish carrying the thing I say.

text: Wo àwòrán yìí. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, màá sì lu dùndún!
en: Look at this picture. Tap Fúnkẹ́, say its name in English, and I will beat the dundun!

text: Àwọn oníbàárà ti dé! Tètè fún ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan ní ohun tó béèrè.
en: The shoppers are here! Quickly give each one what they ask for.

text: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lára ọkọ̀ ojú omi kọ̀ọ̀kan, kí o sì tẹ̀ èyí tó bá àwòrán mu.
en: Read the word on each canoe, then tap the one that matches the picture.

text: Jẹ́ ká ta ayò! Tẹ àwọn kóró tó ní lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan, kí wọ́n bọ́ sínú ihò.
en: Let's play ayo! Tap the seeds with the word's letters one after another, and they drop into the pits.

text: Jẹ́ ká kọ́ ilé náà kí àkókò tó tán! Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, kí o sì sọ àwọn lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan. Lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan jẹ́ bíríkì kan.
en: Let's build the house before time runs out! Tap Fúnkẹ́ and say the word's letters one by one. Every letter is a brick.

text: Kò burú! Jẹ́ ká jọ bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti máa bá a lọ.
en: No problem! Let's start learning together. Tap Fúnkẹ́ to continue.

text: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti máa bá a lọ.
en: Tap Fúnkẹ́ to continue.

text: Sọ lẹ́tà tó wà lórí àsíá ẹlẹ́ṣin náà, yóò sì kí Ọba!
en: Say the letter on the rider's banner, and he will greet the Oba!

text: Bí eré yìí ṣe ń lọ nìyí: sọ lẹ́tà tí o rí lórí àsíá ẹlẹ́ṣin náà, kí inú Ọba lè dùn.
en: Here is how the game works: say the letter you see on the rider's banner, so the Oba is happy.

text: Báyìí, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ ká bẹ̀rẹ̀.
en: Now press Fúnkẹ́ and we'll start.

text: Sọ orúkọ nǹkan yìí ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, alàtẹ yóò sì tà á!
en: Say this thing's name in English, and the market caller will sell it!

text: Sọ ohun tí o fẹ́ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, ẹni tó ń tà á yóò sì fún ọ!
en: Say what you want in English, and the seller will give it to you!

text: Tẹ̀ òkìtì tí iye àpò kòkó rẹ̀ jẹ́ iye tí mo bá sọ.
en: Tap the stack with as many cocoa sacks as the number I say.

text: Tẹ̀ èyí tí iye owó rẹ̀ bá ohun tí mo sọ mu.
en: Tap the one whose price matches what I say.

text: Ka àwọn màlúù tó wà nínú ọgbà, kí o sì sọ iye wọn ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Count the cows in the pen and say how many in English.

text: Bí eré yìí ṣe ń lọ nìyí: ka àwọn màlúù tó wà nínú ọgbà, lẹ́yìn náà sọ iye wọn ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
en: Here is how the game works: count the cows in the pen, then say how many in English.

text: Sọ iye owó tó wà lọ́wọ́ rẹ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì san owó fún ẹni tó ń ta bọ̀lì.
en: Say the money in your hand in English, and pay the boli seller.

text: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lórí ìlẹ̀kùn sókè, gbẹ́nàgbẹ́nà yóò sì gbẹ́ ẹ.
en: Read the word on the door out loud, and the carver will carve it.

text: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lára ọkọ̀ náà sókè, yóò sì dé etí omi.
en: Read the word on the boat out loud, and it will come to the bank.

text: Sọ àwọn lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan, tàbí kí o tẹ̀ wọ́n lórí pátákó ìtẹ̀wé, akọ̀wé lẹ́tà yóò sì kọ wọ́n.
en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and the letter writer will write them.

text: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lórí ìkùukùu sókè, òjò yóò sì rọ̀ sórí oko.
en: Read the word on the cloud out loud, and the rain will fall on the farm.

text: Sọ àwọn lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan, tàbí kí o tẹ̀ wọ́n lórí pátákó ìtẹ̀wé, aláró yóò sì pa aṣọ náà láró.
en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and the dyer will dye the cloth.

text: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká ṣe eré kan pẹ̀lú àwọn lẹ́tà tí o ti kọ́!
en: Now let's play a game with the letters you've learned!

text: O ti fẹ́rẹ̀ ẹ́ ṣe é! Jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.
en: You were close! Let's try once more.

text: Báyìí, o lè ṣe eré yìí nígbàkígbà tí o bá fẹ́, láti ojú-ìwé àkọ́kọ́.
en: Now you can play this game whenever you like, from the home page.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà àádọ́ta.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 50 gold.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà ọgọ́rùn-ún.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 100 gold.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà àádọ́jọ.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 150 gold.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà igba.
en: Well done! You earned three stars and 200 gold.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà àádọ́ta.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 50 gold.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà ọgọ́rùn-ún.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 100 gold.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà àádọ́jọ.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 150 gold.

text: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà igba.
en: Well done! You earned four stars and 200 gold.

text: Báyìí, o ti di Ọmọ Ààfin!
en: Now you are a Ọmọ Ààfin!

text: Báyìí, o ti di Akọni!
en: Now you are a Akọni!

text: Báyìí, o ti di Olùkọ́!
en: Now you are a Olùkọ́!

text: Báyìí, o ti di Ọmọ Ọba!
en: Now you are a Ọmọ Ọba!

text: Báyìí, o ti di Àrólé!
en: Now you are a Àrólé!

text: Báyìí, o ti di Ọba!
en: Now you are a Ọba!

text: Akitiyan rẹ ti mú ọ dé ipò tuntun!
en: Your effort has brought you to a new level!

text: Àpò wúrà rẹ àkọ́kọ́ ti kún!
en: Your first bag of gold is full!

text: Àpò wúrà rẹ kejì ti kún!
en: Your second bag of gold is full!

text: Àpò wúrà rẹ kẹta ti kún!
en: Your third bag of gold is full!

text: Àpò wúrà rẹ kẹrin ti kún!
en: Your fourth bag of gold is full!

text: Àpò wúrà rẹ karùn-ún ti kún!
en: Your fifth bag of gold is full!

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún kan.
en: Your gold has reached 1,000.

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún méjì.
en: Your gold has reached 2,000.

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́rin.
en: Your gold has reached 4,000.

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́fà.
en: Your gold has reached 6,000.

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́jọ.
en: Your gold has reached 8,000.

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́wàá.
en: Your gold has reached 10,000.

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún méjìlá.
en: Your gold has reached 12,000.

text: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́rìndínlógún.
en: Your gold has reached 16,000.

text: Èyí ni ipò àkọ́kọ́. Ipò mẹ́rin mìíràn ṣì wà níwájú.
en: This is the first level. There are four more levels ahead.

text: Máa gbìyànjú, títí o fi máa di Ọba!
en: Keep trying, until you become an Oba!

text: Máa sapá báyìí!
en: Keep up the effort like this!

text: Èyí ni ipò tó ga jùlọ!
en: This is the highest level of all!

text: Máa kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ lójoojúmọ́!
en: Keep learning every day!
